description: CREAF publishes oil_palm_global, a short Google Earth Engine workflow for preparing Sentinel composites used in global oil-palm classification. The documented script combines Sentinel-1 VV and VH radar bands with Sentinel-2 band 4. GitHub exposes the JavaScript source and README, while Zenodo archives version 1.0 and links the associated 2019 plantation dataset. The archive labels the licence Other Open and access is free, but GitHub does not state a specific licence text. The Earth Engine script and imagery services were not executed or accessed beyond their public documentation. This is an image-preparation component, not the complete plantation classifier or an agricultural production model. Its usefulness is to reproduce input imagery before estimating plantation extent for food-supply, land-use or freight-demand simulations. Transfer to a different year or location requires checking dates, cloud handling and input availability. It complements the published oil-palm maps by making one processing step reusable.
